org_okrs.objective: Ensure incoming corps members are fully prepared, supported, and retained through preservice
org_okrs.key_result: 100% of incoming CMs have participated in at least one interview by May 31 · 90% retention of incoming CMs · 90% of ICMs at 100% completion on matriculation/onboarding/hiring tasks

org_okrs.objective: Be 100% ready to execute summer school
org_okrs.key_result: Federal Way alignment documented by May 31 · Seasonal staff + regional team fully hired and onboarded · FT staff execution-ready with 100% of core deliverables complete

org_okrs.objective: Retain and develop corps members as the primary driver of student impact
org_okrs.key_result: Retain 98% of CMs through EOY · 95% belonging score on EOY survey · 90%+ favorable principal survey across rehire, TFA support, recommend · Touchpoint with every current partner

org_okrs.objective: Create a high-quality alumni experience that fosters belonging, clarity, and meaningful engagement
org_okrs.key_result: 200+ attendees at alumni induction · 8–10 specific alumni recruited into the room · 90% alumni rate experience favorably
org_okrs.next_step: Lock the 8–10 target list and start individualized outreach

org_okrs.objective: Raise the revenue to sustain the work
org_okrs.key_result: Raise $500K by May 31 · Deliver FY27 development plan (pipeline, goals, campaigns, stewardship, comms, ops) · Activate Board Fundraising Committee · Launch annual stewardship plan
org_okrs.next_step: Confirm top 10 prospect moves for April–May

org_okrs.objective: Build an AI-fluent, high-retention team and board
org_okrs.key_result: 80% board retention · Team demonstrates AI dexterity across meeting prep, coaching, and data analysis

function_okrs.key_result: 30% (12) of 2026 corps have secured roles by end of Q4
Participate in 20 new school-leader meetings with principals who haven't hired a CM, by June 15
Attend 2–3 community engagement events by June 1
Develop 2 new marketing factsheets targeted for principals and district leaders by May 1
Spotlight 6 incoming 2026 CMs on LinkedIn by June 1
100% (2/2) renewing schools sign renewal contract by 6/10 · 100% (2/2) sign increased cost-sharing 1–1.5% from FY25
Engage 15–20 alumni in defined roles (ICM mock interviews, school-leader referrals, hiring fair participation) by end of Q4
function_okrs.next_step: Finalize role menu and outreach list

function_okrs.key_result: Board FRC owns fall event push and individualized networking
Deliver refreshed pipeline, quarterly goals, campaign pyramid, stewardship + comms + ops plan
